source_id: arXiv:2610.29732v1 (C. B. Muratov, M. Novaga), Theorem 1, p. 4
quote:
Theorem 1. For every Bravais lattice L ⊂ R3 of covolume one we have
E(L) ≥ E(LB ),
with equality if and only if L is equal to LB , up to an orthogonal transformation.
hypotheses: L ranges over Bravais lattices in R^3 of covolume one
E(L) is the Born Coulombic lattice energy, equal to the continued Epstein zeta function E(L, 1/2), eqs. (6)-(9)
L_B is the covolume-one BCC lattice of eq. (10)
used_for: B3 section 2: lattice-restricted bcc optimality; the non-periodic problem is not covered
